provenance.note: Built from XR Guild's own description of itself and the brand guide. The research stage did not run: it requires an authenticated browser session that was not available. No external or third-party claims are made on any slide, and no statistics are cited.

slides.headline: You don't need to own a headset to try one.
slides.visual_job: Lens texture behind. Wordmark top-left. Single display headline filling the lower two thirds.

slides.headline: Most people never try XR.
slides.body: Not for lack of curiosity. Because finding out whether you even like it costs several hundred dollars up front.
slides.visual_job: Flat indigo. No texture. Headline over body, generous space.

slides.headline: That is what a community is for.
slides.body: Somewhere the headset already exists, and somebody hands it to you.
slides.visual_job: Flat indigo. Cyan rule above the headline as the single accent.

slides.headline: XR Guild is one of them.
slides.body: A 501(c)3 non-profit, founded in 2022 and run entirely by volunteers. Its members work across XR and spatial computing under a shared set of ethical principles.
slides.visual_job: Panel card on indigo to separate the factual block from the argument.

slides.headline: And it throws demo nights.
slides.body: In a bar, with tables of headsets and people who are glad to show you how any of it works.
slides.visual_job: Lens texture, dimmed. Headline anchored low.

slides.headline: Beginners are the point.
slides.body: Not a tolerated edge case. If you have never worn one, you are exactly who the night is for — and you do not have to join anything to walk in.
slides.visual_job: Flat indigo. Cyan sets only the word Beginners.

slides.headline: There is probably one near you.
slides.body: XR meetups run in cities all over. Search your city and “XR” or “VR meetup”. If nothing turns up, four people and one headset is a real start.
slides.visual_job: Flat indigo. The generalising slide — this one carries the awareness goal beyond XR Guild itself.

slides.headline: The headset gets passed around.
slides.visual_job: Lens texture. Wordmark. The no-barrier pill in cyan, which the brand guide makes mandatory on event-facing work. Luma handle in mono.
